title: RIGHT TO SAFETY
content:
Everyone has the right to life, liberty and security of person. In an emergency situation:

• Right to protection from emergency services
• Right to medical assistance
• Right to information about risks
• Right to evacuation if necessary

title: DUTY TO ASSIST
content:
Everyone must assist a person in danger, to the extent of their means:

• Duty to provide assistance (Art. 223-6 of the French Penal Code)
• Duty to call emergency services
• Duty not to worsen the situation
• Duty to follow instructions

title: RIGHT TO INFORMATION
content:
In an emergency, everyone has the right:

• To clear and understandable information
• To know the risks faced
• To receive safety instructions
• To be informed of the situation's evolution

title: DUTY OF COOPERATION
content:
Persons must cooperate with emergency services:

• Respect evacuation orders
• Do not hinder rescue operations
• Communicate useful information
• Facilitate access to locations
